messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Canary pool 'redwood-canary-eu-3' error-rate spike detected. 5m error rate = 6.8% (threshold 3%). Affected route: /v1/generate (text-gen).
Maya: on it. paging oncall. seeing increased 5xx?
Sam: looking at logs -> a subset of requests hitting tokenizer service fail with OOM-ish stack traces, but overall host CPU fine. error signature: "kv-cache allocation failed" in tokenizer init.
Anika: Is this the new tokenizer rollout we scheduled in the canary earlier?
Maya: yes, rolled at 11:42 UTC, started trending at ~11:46.
Leo: If it's the tokenizer change, we can flip the feature flag to redirect to the old tokenizer variant. We have a kill switch flag 'tokenizer_v2' for that.
Maya: good call. ops-bot, can you flip flag to off for canary and prod routing? want to stop impact now.
ops-bot: Running two-phase flag kill: 1) canary-only -> 2) gradual prod (if metrics normal). Command: 
```
# flip off for canary
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"tokenizer_v2","env":"canary","value":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```
ops-bot: canary traffic should switch back within ~30s after edge config refresh.
Maya: flipping now.
Maya: flipped. waiting on metrics.
Sam: metrics show errors dropping in canary after ~45s. error-rate back to 0.9% in canary.
Emily: good. but we still have some user-facing errors from the short window. any customer impact numbers?
Anika: rough estimate from tracing: ~1.8% of live requests between 11:46-11:49 got 5xx or truncated responses. Most were short-lived and retried by client. no major downstream SLO breach yet.
Maya: ok, mitigation worked. next: do we want to revert the single commit that rolled tokenizer_v2, or ship a micropatch?
Leo: quick revert of the commit that introduced the change seems safest. it's a single PR (sha: a1b2c3d4). we can revert -> canary deploy -> promote.
Sam: agreed. I can do the revert and push a hotfix branch. I'll coordinate deploy with Maya/ops.
Maya: assign ops for canary rollout monitoring. QA Bot, please run smoke tests on canary once deployed.
QA Bot: queued: smoke suite for /v1/generate and tokenizer unit surface tests. will post results.
Sam: doing local revert now: 
```
git checkout main
git pull origin main
git revert -m 1 a1b2c3d4 -m "revert: rollback tokenizer_v2 due to canary OOM"
git push origin HEAD:hotfix/revert-tokenizer-v2
```
Sam: Created PR #4123 -> hotfix/revert-tokenizer-v2. Please review fast.
Anika: LGTM from product side. Maya: you okay with canary deploy?
Maya: yes. schedule canary now. Sam, trigger the canary deploy when ready. ops-bot, hold prod promotion until green.
ops-bot: canary deploy started at 11:59 UTC. rolling across 3 canary nodes sequentially.
Sam: canary instance 1 healthy. smoke tests pass on 1/3.
QA Bot: smoke suite: 1) /v1/generate basic -> pass, 2) tokenizer edge cases -> pass, 3) perf quick check -> within expected.
Sam: canary 2 deployed -> smoke pass. canary 3 deployed -> smoke pass. all canaries green at 12:04 UTC.
Maya: promoting to prod with 10% traffic for safety, holding for 5m observation window.
Anika: will we also re-enable tokenizer_v2 flag later in a controlled rollout once we fix memory allocation?
Leo: yes, devs will root-cause the kv-cache growth and either cap allocations or change init path. plan is to rework before any full rollout.
ops-bot: prod promotion at 12:06 UTC to 10% traffic.
Sam: quick note on reverting vs patching: since revert is clean and tests pass, we avoid rushed micropatch that could miss edge. revert seems lower-risk.
Emily: Customer comms: Looks low impact overall, but a handful of customers in EU during window may have noticed errors. Can we draft a short note for Customer Success?
Maya: @Emily please draft with: what happened, mitigation (kill flag + revert), time window, rough affected percent, and follow-up (postmortem + root cause).
Emily: on it. ETA 20m.
SRE Rotation: I'll take the on-call handoff at 12:30 UTC. Maya, any remaining action items for me?
Maya: tidy up: 1) ensure post-deploy monitoring alerts remain green for next 30m, 2) keep the tokenization flag off by default, 3) collect heap/profile dumps from failing hosts (Sam to attach), 4) schedule RCA meeting with dev + ML infra in next 24h.
Sam: attaching list of failing host ids and trace ids to the issue -> LINK: https://redwood.internal/ops/issues/INC-7890 (posted).
Anika: I've flagged the PR that introduced the allocator change for an engineering review. we'll prioritise a follow-up fix sprint.
Maya: thanks everyone. set incident status to 'mitigated' for now. Add warm handoff note for SRE Rotation.
incident-bot: Incident INC-7890 updated -> state: mitigated. responders: Maya, Sam, Anika, Leo, Emily.
SRE Rotation: taking over. I'll keep the channel updated every 15m until stable. assigning follow-up tasks in the ticket.
Maya: great. postmortem owner? Anika or Sam can take.
Anika: I can own the postmortem. will capture timeline and action items.
Maya: excellent. thanks team. :thumbsup:
